subject: Kaka (Ricardo Izecson dos Santos Leite)
title: Kaka cried at his Hall of Fame night

lines.vo: Kaka cried on the San Siro pitch. Nobody blamed the onions.
lines.footage: Kaka Milan Hall of Fame ceremony San Siro

lines.vo: Milan inducted him into the Hall of Fame on the pitch before the derby. A full San Siro watched him cry. Brave.
lines.footage: Milan Hall of Fame ceremony derby day 2026

lines.vo: Diego Moreira wore Kaka's number twenty-two. He scored a free kick. Then he thanked Kaka for the number. Free number, free kick. Milan won three-one.
lines.footage: Milan 3-1 Inter Moreira free kick highlights

lines.vo: Kaka then suggested an old Shevchenko chant for Christian Pulisic. Pulisic is in good form. The chant consultant is working.
Raphinha wears the Brazil number ten Kaka wore at the 2010 World Cup. No pressure, Raphinha.
In the video game, Kaka is rated one hundred twenty-four. Real Kaka is a chant consultant. The pixels are doing better.
lines.footage: EA FC Mobile Kaka Icon card reveal

lines.vo: Your mates will never guess this. Match news and betting tips at aboutfootball dot UK.

inserts.story: Cartoon Milan fans wave scarves while a caricature of Kaka sheds one oversized tear that drips into a tiny bucket. Gag: the bucket overflows into a puddle and a cartoon groundsman wades in. Twist: he switches off the sprinklers and says, no need, we have Kaka.
inserts.characters: generic cartoon fans and groundsman; caricature of Kaka

inserts.story: A cartoon number 22 shirt hangs in a locker with a sticky note reading Property of Kaka. A caricature of Moreira borrows it politely and scores a free kick. Twist: he returns it dry-cleaned with a thank-you card, signed by the ball too.
inserts.characters: generic cartoon shirt and ball; caricature of Diego Moreira

inserts.story: A cartoon game console shows a card rated 124, and a caricature of Kaka in a tiny headset asks it for a chant idea. Gag: the card shrugs and asks him the same. Twist: both start singing an old chant, and the cartoon crowd sings along.
inserts.characters: generic cartoon console; caricature of Kaka

notes: after_line is 1-based index into lines. Part A uses newest stories. The old Shevchenko chant includes a nationality reference, so the joke is dropped and only the chant idea is kept. Skipped: divorce rumour and family, Baresi tribute, religion, injuries. Pulisic is a footballer only: no nationality joke. Punch-up pass: 'nobody blamed the onions' is a crying joke only; 'Milan won three-one' is from the Moreira pack fact. No joke on health or family.
